method: Every available game analysis body read, SHA-256 deduplicated, and scanned line by line for literal API surfaces. This is an automated index with manual source-guided review, not full semantic proof.
limits: Not original source; reconstruction defects remain.
Literal extraction misses computed keys, calls through aliases/functions and multiline expressions.
A name lookup is a candidate dependency, not proof it was required.
A false uppercase assignment is a search lead, not proof a released feature is disabled.
No server handlers or private player data included.
Roblox platform bodies were preserved and compile-audited previously; they are not game feature implementations.

platform_relevance_check.search_markers: Feral-prefixed identifiers, WolfController, Phantosuchus, exact PlaceId
platform_relevance_check.limit: A literal relevance check and previous compile audit, not a manual semantic review of all Roblox platform implementation.

source_fidelity_note: Baseline official Luau 0.747 compile status reused; accepted syntax does not establish original semantics. See FERAL-source-quality-v3.2.json.
